title: Mystic Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on an ornate base atop a wooden desk. Inside the sphere, a swirling vortex of orange, red and blue energy surrounds a small green character in a hat and scarf, standing on a stylized landscape with a tiny silhouetted figure on a distant hill. Pink lightning and magenta energy bolts erupt from the orb into the dark surrounding space.
prompt: A glowing crystal ball on a dark wooden desk in a dimly lit room, containing a swirling orange and blue energy vortex. Inside stands a small cartoonish green character wearing a fedora and scarf with arms outstretched. A tiny silhouetted figure stands on a distant hill within the orb. Bright pink lightning and magenta energy bolts explode outward from the sphere. Dramatic lighting, painterly digital art style, dark mystical atmosphere.
